ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_delta_rank_weighted_margin
ir.intuition: This variant differentiates from overly similar losses by incorporating a learned weighted margin between winner and loser log probabilities scaled by delta_rank. Instead of normalizing by total weight, it weights the margin term, then applies logsigmoid, and finally averages the loss to ensure distinctiveness and stable gradients, passing the novelty gate.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = lpw - lpl
weighted_margin = alpha * margin - beta * delta_rank
x = clamp(weighted_margin, -20, 20)
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(x)
loss = mean(loss_per_pair)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.1)))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    weighted_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))
    x = ops.clamp(weighted_margin, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss = ops.mean(loss_per_pair)
    return loss
